Baby Name Generator

Discover baby names by gender and origin — Pakistani, Arabic, Western, Indian or Turkish — with meanings, random picks and tap-to-copy.

Tap any name to copy it to your clipboard.

📖 How to use

  1. Choose Boy, Girl, or Any for the gender.
  2. Pick an origin: Pakistani, Arabic, Western, Indian or Turkish.
  3. Select how many names you'd like to see, then click “Generate Names”.
  4. Tap any name card to copy it to your clipboard.

❓ Frequently asked questions

Where do the names and meanings come from?

From a built-in list of 300 hand-picked names (30 boys' and 30 girls' names per origin) with commonly accepted meanings.

Can I mix boys' and girls' names?

Yes — choose “Any” as the gender and you'll get a random mix from both lists of the selected origin.

Are name meanings always exact?

Meanings reflect the most commonly cited ones, but names can have multiple interpretations across cultures — treat them as a guide.
